change: Optional --revision freezes exact committed Git blobs for a separate owner review, excluding simultaneous working-tree edits. Default working-file mode retained; no existing Studio folder is overwritten.
unit_scope: Modified, staged, deleted and untracked files cannot leak into a revision snapshot
Exact binary/CRLF/Unicode-path blob contents and SHA256s match
Default mode still copies current working files
Existing target, invalid revision and committed symlink are refused
Twelve unsafe Windows path/case-collision variants are refused before copying
A target created concurrently during Git reads is preserved by atomic reservation
failed_or_interrupted_probe: First full-repository verification used two Git processes per file and was explicitly stopped as too slow; no assertion failure or review startup occurred. Replaced that probe's verification with independent length-prefixed blob hashes against one Git tree listing, preserving the same exact-byte oracle. Both disposable copies retained until remote verification.
scope: Source-freezing tool only. No review application startup, native project replay, human/device acceptance or full aggregate is claimed by this CPU increment. Startup still runs the unchanged private-desktop validation when the builder is invoked normally.
